images.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create exactly ONE full-body Keeper character turnaround image, direction SW, on a portrait canvas matching Image 1. Image 1 is the APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER, direction S: use it to preserve the same young woman, face, dark curly tied-back hair mass, sun-browned skin, proportions, costume, every item and its anatomical side, and even-weight standing rest pose. Rotate the CHARACTER 45 degrees toward screen-left from the reference S pose: she faces the viewer's LOWER-LEFT, front and anatomical right side visible, face looking lower-left. The plain upright walnut staff in her anatomical RIGHT hand is SCREEN-LEFT, nearer the camera. The olive canvas satchel on her anatomical LEFT hip is screen-right, farther away. The single diagonal chestnut harness stays over her RIGHT shoulder and leads to her LEFT hip. This is a true rotation, never a mirror. Arms relaxed, right hand holding staff upright, left arm resting by side, both feet planted, weight even.
Camera: fixed elevated three-quarter pinhole view from the front, approximately 53 degrees above the ground plane, projection C. Character rotates; camera does not. Full body centered, feet fully visible, same standing height and portrait framing as Image 1. Single character only.
Identity and equipment unchanged: early-20s woman, visible face, no helmet; ivory linen shirt, navy sleeveless tabard with completely PLAIN chest, ONE chestnut diagonal harness strap, olive canvas satchel at LEFT hip, ONE waist belt, chestnut laced bracers, navy trousers, chestnut buckled boots. PLAIN dark walnut staff with small brass ferrules at foot and tip in RIGHT hand; no ring, no head-piece. No insignia or emblems anywhere, every surface plain. No additional objects.
Style: painted 2D illustration, high resolution, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, readable small silhouette, no conspicuous brush or grain. Preserve the reference's blue / ivory / brass palette and material identity. Light: single key fixed at SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on key-facing edge. Light does not rotate with character. No spell glow, no warm or saturated light source. NO floor shadows.
Background: perfectly flat uniform pure #00ff00 covering the whole canvas to every edge. No gradient, no texture, no floor, no scenery, no checkerboard, no transparency, no matting. Deliver one portrait image.

references.role: APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER (direction S): identity, costume, proportions, pose and register

concerns: Followed the task-specific portrait requirement: output is 1024×1536, not the register's 2×2 sheet or registered 512×512 frame.
Face turns screen-left, but torso and feet appear less rotated than the requested 45 degrees; the near-right-side relationship is not clearly established.
Exact projection-C elevation, identity preservation and uniform #00ff00 pixel values were not deterministically verified.
